meta.description: How Teknoppy built mountbell.com for a Kerala overseas education consultancy, with dedicated country pages, separated immigration services, and a two-office local presence.

sections.h1Lead: Mount Bell Global Studies: A Website Built for a

paragraphs.text: Mount Bell Global Studies is a Kerala-based Overseas Education Consultancy headquartered in Thrissur with a second office in Kochi, representing universities and colleges across 15+ countries.

items.title: No dedicated page per study destination
items.text: With destinations across 13+ countries, study options likely sat undifferentiated, making it hard for a prospective student to research region-specific requirements and options.

items.title: Immigration and study-abroad services blurred together
items.text: Without separate positioning, migration services could easily be confused with student study-abroad consultancy in the same navigation.

items.title: No visible dual-office presence
items.text: Kochi and Thrissur locations weren't both clearly surfaced, limiting local relevance for students researching from either city.

items.title: No trust-building content
items.text: Without testimonials or blog content, prospective students had little social proof or educational context to build confidence before committing to a major life decision.

paragraphs.text: Teknoppy's goal was to build a website that could guide prospective students through a genuinely wide range of study destinations and services — from career counseling to visa support to migration — without the site feeling like an undifferentiated wall of options for a decision this significant.

sections.h2: A comprehensive range of services offered by Teknoppy and their outcomes

items.title: Dedicated pages for 13 study destinations
items.text: UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, France, Germany, Dubai, Sweden, Netherlands, Finland, Latvia, and Malta each have their own page under Countries, rather than one generic destinations page.

items.title: Immigration kept distinct from study-abroad services
items.text: Immigration sits as its own top-level navigation item, separate from country-specific study programs, so visitors researching migration aren't mixed in with student consultancy.

items.title: Both offices surfaced clearly
items.text: Kochi and Thrissur addresses and phone numbers are both listed, giving students in either city a direct local contact point.

items.title: Testimonials and blog content build trust
items.text: Named student testimonials and a blog of study-abroad guidance content give prospective students social proof and educational context for a major decision.

items.q: What was the main goal of the Mount Bell Global Studies website project?
items.a: To build a website that could guide prospective students through a wide range of study destinations and services without feeling overwhelming for a major life decision.

items.q: Which countries does Mount Bell Global Studies cover?
items.a: UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, France, Germany, Dubai, Sweden, Netherlands, Finland, Latvia, and Malta, among others.

items.q: Did the project affect Mount Bell's existing rankings?
items.a: The project was scoped to avoid keyword cannibalization across the site's country and service pages — no overlapping targets were introduced.

items.q: Does Mount Bell Global Studies handle both study-abroad consultancy and immigration?
items.a: Yes — the site keeps Immigration as a distinct offering from its country-specific study-abroad consultancy services.
